meta_description: Foster Tree Specialists in Leicester offers expert tree surgery, felling, and pruning. Fully insured arborists serving Leicestershire. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured Arborists — Safe, Professional Tree Care
hero_subhead: Dangerous tree? Storm damage? We safely remove, prune, and care for your trees across Leicestershire.
services_heading: Complete Tree Care Services Across Leicestershire
services_subhead: From routine pruning to emergency felling, we handle every aspect of tree maintenance with expertise and safety.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled removal of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees. We handle site clearance and stump grinding to leave your garden ready for replanting.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Thin out overgrown branches to restore shape and light. Regular pruning extends tree life and reduces storm risk.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Fallen or damaged trees causing danger? We respond quickly to make the area safe and remove hazardous limbs.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Keep hedgerows neat and healthy with professional cutting. We shape them safely and dispose of all waste.

services.title: Tree Health Assessment
services.desc: Worried about a tree? Our arborists inspect for disease, pest damage, and structural weakness before problems escalate.

services.title: Site Clearance & Timber Chipping
services.desc: After felling, we chip branches on-site or haul them away responsibly. Stumps ground flush with the soil.

about_pullquote: We treat every tree like it matters — because it does to your home.
about_para_1: Foster Tree Specialists was established in 2007 by Mark Foster, an experienced arborist who'd seen too many amateur tree jobs go wrong. We've since grown into Leicestershire's most trusted tree care team, completing over 1,200 safe removals and countless pruning jobs. Every team member holds current NPTC qualifications and we're fully insured for all aspects of tree work, from hedge cutting to complex felling in confined spaces.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, doing the job right, and cleaning up thoroughly — no mess left behind. Customers call us back because we listen, explain what needs doing, and price fairly without hidden charges. Whether you need a one-off prune or emergency storm clearance, we arrive with the right equipment and the skill to do it safely.
reviews_heading: What Leicestershire Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Massive oak tree was leaning after the storms. Called Foster on a Friday afternoon and they came out Saturday morning. Did the felling safely, ground the stump, and left the garden spotless. Professional outfit, fair pricing. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had a quote from three other tree surgeons. Mark was the most honest — told me I didn't need the full removal, just pruning would do the job. Saved me £300 and the tree looks great now. That's integrity.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Emergency call at 7am — large branch hanging over our conservatory. They arrived within two hours, took it down carefully, no damage to the roof or fence. Brilliant response and excellent workmanship. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Robert T.
